---
title: "Molecule Viewer"
description: "Browser-based molecular structure viewer for PDB, XYZ, SDF, and MOL2 files."
---

```{=html}
<section class="viewer-page" aria-labelledby="viewer-title">
  <div class="viewer-intro">
    <p class="eyebrow">Kabir Lab Molecular Tools</p>
    <h1 id="viewer-title">Molecule Viewer</h1>
    <p class="lead-copy">Inspect molecular structures directly in the browser with local file loading, PDB lookup, and common molecular representations.</p>
  </div>

  <section class="molecule-viewer-shell" aria-label="Molecular structure viewer">
    <div class="molecule-viewer-toolbar" aria-label="Viewer controls">
      <label class="viewer-field">
        <span>Structure file</span>
        <input id="moleculeFileInput" type="file" accept=".pdb,.xyz,.sdf,.mol2">
      </label>

      <label class="viewer-field viewer-pdb-field">
        <span>PDB ID</span>
        <input id="moleculePdbInput" type="text" maxlength="4" placeholder="1CRN" autocomplete="off" inputmode="text">
      </label>

      <button class="viewer-button primary" id="moleculeLoadPdbButton" type="button">Load PDB</button>
      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeSampleButton" type="button">Sample</button>

      <label class="viewer-field">
        <span>Style</span>
        <select id="moleculeRepresentation">
          <option value="default">Default</option>
          <option value="cartoon">Cartoon</option>
          <option value="stick">Ball and stick</option>
          <option value="sphere">Space filling</option>
          <option value="line">Wireframe</option>
          <option value="backbone">Backbone</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeResetButton" type="button">Reset</button>
      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeSpinButton" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Spin</button>
      <button class="viewer-button" id="moleculeDownloadButton" type="button">Image</button>
    </div>

    <div class="molecule-viewer-layout">
      <div class="molecule-viewer-stage">
        <div id="moleculeViewer" aria-label="Interactive molecular viewer">
          <canvas id="moleculeCanvas"></canvas>
        </div>
      </div>

      <aside class="molecule-viewer-side" aria-label="Structure information">
        <div>
          <span class="viewer-status-label">Status</span>
          <p id="moleculeStatus">Loading sample molecule...</p>
        </div>

        <div class="viewer-meta-grid">
          <span>Format</span>
          <strong id="moleculeFormat">XYZ</strong>
          <span>Source</span>
          <strong id="moleculeSource">Sample</strong>
          <span>Atoms</span>
          <strong id="moleculeAtomCount">-</strong>
          <span>Bonds</span>
          <strong id="moleculeBondCount">-</strong>
        </div>

        <p class="viewer-note">Local files remain in the browser. PDB ID loading fetches public structure files from RCSB.</p>
      </aside>
    </div>
  </section>
</section>

<script>
(function () {
  const sampleXyz = `12
Benzene sample
C      0.0000      1.4027      0.0000
H      0.0000      2.4903      0.0000
C     -1.2148      0.7014      0.0000
H     -2.1567      1.2451      0.0000
C     -1.2148     -0.7014      0.0000
H     -2.1567     -1.2451      0.0000
C      0.0000     -1.4027      0.0000
H      0.0000     -2.4903      0.0000
C      1.2148     -0.7014      0.0000
H      2.1567     -1.2451      0.0000
C      1.2148      0.7014      0.0000
H      2.1567      1.2451      0.0000`;

  const elementColors = {
    H: "#f2f4f5",
    C: "#4d5960",
    N: "#1f64d1",
    O: "#d8322f",
    F: "#34a853",
    P: "#e18a1a",
    S: "#e0b629",
    CL: "#35a85a",
    BR: "#8f342f",
    I: "#7b4fb2"
  };

  const covalentRadii = {
    H: 0.31,
    C: 0.76,
    N: 0.71,
    O: 0.66,
    F: 0.57,
    P: 1.07,
    S: 1.05,
    CL: 1.02,
    BR: 1.2,
    I: 1.39
  };

  const chainColors = ["#0d6770", "#d66b2f", "#2f6bb2", "#6b8d3f", "#7b4fb2", "#b23f63"];

  const canvas = document.getElementById("moleculeCanvas");
  const viewerElement = document.getElementById("moleculeViewer");
  const statusElement = document.getElementById("moleculeStatus");
  const formatElement = document.getElementById("moleculeFormat");
  const sourceElement = document.getElementById("moleculeSource");
  const atomCountElement = document.getElementById("moleculeAtomCount");
  const bondCountElement = document.getElementById("moleculeBondCount");
  const representationElement = document.getElementById("moleculeRepresentation");
  const spinButton = document.getElementById("moleculeSpinButton");
  const ctx = canvas ? canvas.getContext("2d") : null;

  let atoms = [];
  let bonds = [];
  let currentFormat = "xyz";
  let currentSource = "Sample";
  let center = { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 };
  let radius = 1;
  let rotation = { x: -0.55, y: 0.72, z: 0 };
  let zoom = 1;
  let isSpinning = false;
  let animationId = null;
  let isDragging = false;
  let lastPointer = { x: 0, y: 0 };

  function showStatus(message, isError) {
    if (!statusElement) {
      return;
    }

    statusElement.textContent = message;
    statusElement.classList.toggle("is-error", Boolean(isError));
  }

  function setMeta(format, source) {
    formatElement.textContent = format.toUpperCase();
    sourceElement.textContent = source;
    atomCountElement.textContent = String(atoms.length);
    bondCountElement.textContent = String(bonds.length);
  }

  function normalizeElement(value, atomName) {
    const raw = String(value || "").trim();
    if (raw) {
      const up = raw.toUpperCase();
      if (up.startsWith("CL")) return "CL";
      if (up.startsWith("BR")) return "BR";
      return up[0] || "C";
    }

    const fallback = String(atomName || "").replace(/[0-9]/g, "").trim().toUpperCase();
    if (fallback.startsWith("CL")) return "CL";
    if (fallback.startsWith("BR")) return "BR";
    return fallback[0] || "C";
  }

  function elementColor(element) {
    return elementColors[element] || "#6c7a80";
  }

  function elementRadius(element) {
    return covalentRadii[element] || 0.77;
  }

  function detectFormat(filename) {
    const extension = filename.split(".").pop().toLowerCase();
    const formats = {
      pdb: "pdb",
      xyz: "xyz",
      sdf: "sdf",
      mol2: "mol2"
    };

    if (!formats[extension]) {
      throw new Error("Use a PDB, XYZ, SDF, or MOL2 file.");
    }

    return formats[extension];
  }

  function parseNumber(value) {
    const number = Number.parseFloat(value);
    return Number.isFinite(number) ? number : null;
  }

  function parseXyz(data) {
    const lines = data.split(/\r?\n/).map(line => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const atomTotal = Number.parseInt(lines[0], 10);
    const atomLines = Number.isFinite(atomTotal) ? lines.slice(2, 2 + atomTotal) : lines;

    atoms = atomLines.map((line, index) => {
      const parts = line.split(/\s+/);
      return {
        index,
        serial: index + 1,
        name: parts[0],
        element: normalizeElement(parts[0]),
        x: parseNumber(parts[1]),
        y: parseNumber(parts[2]),
        z: parseNumber(parts[3])
      };
    }).filter(atom => atom.x !== null && atom.y !== null && atom.z !== null);

    bonds = guessBonds(atoms);
  }

  function parsePdb(data) {
    const lines = data.split(/\r?\n/);
    const serialToIndex = new Map();
    const conectBonds = new Set();

    atoms = lines
      .filter(line => line.startsWith("ATOM") || line.startsWith("HETATM"))
      .map((line, index) => {
        const serial = Number.parseInt(line.slice(6, 11), 10);
        const name = line.slice(12, 16).trim();
        const element = normalizeElement(line.slice(76, 78), name);
        const atom = {
          index,
          serial: Number.isFinite(serial) ? serial : index + 1,
          record: line.slice(0, 6).trim(),
          name,
          element,
          chain: line.slice(21, 22).trim(),
          residue: line.slice(17, 20).trim(),
          resSeq: Number.parseInt(line.slice(22, 26), 10),
          x: parseNumber(line.slice(30, 38)),
          y: parseNumber(line.slice(38, 46)),
          z: parseNumber(line.slice(46, 54))
        };
        serialToIndex.set(atom.serial, atom.index);
        return atom;
      })
      .filter(atom => atom.x !== null && atom.y !== null && atom.z !== null);

    lines.filter(line => line.startsWith("CONECT")).forEach(line => {
      const values = line.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(1).map(value => Number.parseInt(value, 10));
      const from = serialToIndex.get(values[0]);
      if (from === undefined) {
        return;
      }

      values.slice(1).forEach(serial => {
        const to = serialToIndex.get(serial);
        if (to === undefined || to === from) {
          return;
        }
        conectBonds.add([from, to].sort((a, b) => a - b).join("-"));
      });
    });

    bonds = Array.from(conectBonds).map(key => key.split("-").map(value => Number.parseInt(value, 10)));
    if (bonds.length < atoms.length * 0.25) {
      bonds = guessBonds(atoms);
    }
  }

  function parseSdf(data) {
    const lines = data.split(/\r?\n/);
    const counts = lines[3] || "";
    const atomTotal = Number.parseInt(counts.slice(0, 3), 10);
    const bondTotal = Number.parseInt(counts.slice(3, 6), 10);
    const atomLines = lines.slice(4, 4 + atomTotal);
    const bondLines = lines.slice(4 + atomTotal, 4 + atomTotal + bondTotal);

    atoms = atomLines.map((line, index) => ({
      index,
      serial: index + 1,
      name: line.slice(31, 34).trim(),
      element: normalizeElement(line.slice(31, 34)),
      x: parseNumber(line.slice(0, 10)),
      y: parseNumber(line.slice(10, 20)),
      z: parseNumber(line.slice(20, 30))
    })).filter(atom => atom.x !== null && atom.y !== null && atom.z !== null);

    bonds = bondLines.map(line => {
      const from = Number.parseInt(line.slice(0, 3), 10) - 1;
      const to = Number.parseInt(line.slice(3, 6), 10) - 1;
      return Number.isFinite(from) && Number.isFinite(to) ? [from, to] : null;
    }).filter(Boolean);

    if (!bonds.length) {
      bonds = guessBonds(atoms);
    }
  }

  function parseMol2(data) {
    const lines = data.split(/\r?\n/);
    const atomStart = lines.findIndex(line => line.toUpperCase().startsWith("@<TRIPOS>ATOM"));
    const bondStart = lines.findIndex(line => line.toUpperCase().startsWith("@<TRIPOS>BOND"));
    const atomEnd = bondStart > atomStart ? bondStart : lines.length;
    const bondEnd = lines.findIndex((line, index) => index > bondStart && line.toUpperCase().startsWith("@<TRIPOS>"));

    atoms = lines.slice(atomStart + 1, atomEnd).map((line, index) => {
      const parts = line.trim().split(/\s+/);
      return {
        index,
        serial: Number.parseInt(parts[0], 10) || index + 1,
        name: parts[1],
        element: normalizeElement((parts[5] || parts[1] || "").split(".")[0], parts[1]),
        x: parseNumber(parts[2]),
        y: parseNumber(parts[3]),
        z: parseNumber(parts[4])
      };
    }).filter(atom => atom.x !== null && atom.y !== null && atom.z !== null);

    bonds = bondStart > -1
      ? lines.slice(bondStart + 1, bondEnd > -1 ? bondEnd : lines.length).map(line => {
          const parts = line.trim().split(/\s+/);
          const from = Number.parseInt(parts[1], 10) - 1;
          const to = Number.parseInt(parts[2], 10) - 1;
          return Number.isFinite(from) && Number.isFinite(to) ? [from, to] : null;
        }).filter(Boolean)
      : [];

    if (!bonds.length) {
      bonds = guessBonds(atoms);
    }
  }

  function guessBonds(atomList) {
    const guessed = [];
    const maxAtomsForGuessing = 2200;

    if (atomList.length > maxAtomsForGuessing) {
      return guessed;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < atomList.length; i += 1) {
      for (let j = i + 1; j < atomList.length; j += 1) {
        const a = atomList[i];
        const b = atomList[j];
        const dx = a.x - b.x;
        const dy = a.y - b.y;
        const dz = a.z - b.z;
        const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
        const threshold = Math.min(2.15, Math.max(0.75, (elementRadius(a.element) + elementRadius(b.element)) * 1.22));

        if (distance > 0.35 && distance <= threshold) {
          guessed.push([i, j]);
        }
      }
    }

    return guessed;
  }

  function parseStructure(data, format) {
    if (format === "xyz") parseXyz(data);
    if (format === "pdb") parsePdb(data);
    if (format === "sdf") parseSdf(data);
    if (format === "mol2") parseMol2(data);

    if (!atoms.length) {
      throw new Error("No atoms could be read from this structure.");
    }

    prepareView();
  }

  function prepareView() {
    const total = atoms.reduce((accumulator, atom) => ({
      x: accumulator.x + atom.x,
      y: accumulator.y + atom.y,
      z: accumulator.z + atom.z
    }), { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 });

    center = {
      x: total.x / atoms.length,
      y: total.y / atoms.length,
      z: total.z / atoms.length
    };

    radius = atoms.reduce((maxDistance, atom) => {
      const dx = atom.x - center.x;
      const dy = atom.y - center.y;
      const dz = atom.z - center.z;
      return Math.max(maxDistance, Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz));
    }, 1);
  }

  function resizeCanvas() {
    const box = viewerElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    const ratio = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    const width = Math.max(320, Math.floor(box.width));
    const height = Math.max(320, Math.floor(box.height));

    if (canvas.width !== Math.floor(width * ratio) || canvas.height !== Math.floor(height * ratio)) {
      canvas.width = Math.floor(width * ratio);
      canvas.height = Math.floor(height * ratio);
      canvas.style.width = width + "px";
      canvas.style.height = height + "px";
      ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    }

    return { width, height };
  }

  function projectAtom(atom, width, height) {
    const px = atom.x - center.x;
    const py = atom.y - center.y;
    const pz = atom.z - center.z;
    const cosY = Math.cos(rotation.y);
    const sinY = Math.sin(rotation.y);
    const cosX = Math.cos(rotation.x);
    const sinX = Math.sin(rotation.x);
    const cosZ = Math.cos(rotation.z);
    const sinZ = Math.sin(rotation.z);

    const x1 = px * cosY + pz * sinY;
    const z1 = -px * sinY + pz * cosY;
    const y1 = py * cosX - z1 * sinX;
    const z2 = py * sinX + z1 * cosX;
    const x2 = x1 * cosZ - y1 * sinZ;
    const y2 = x1 * sinZ + y1 * cosZ;
    const scale = Math.min(width, height) * 0.32 * zoom / Math.max(radius, 0.1);
    const depth = 1 + z2 / Math.max(radius * 5, 1);

    return {
      atom,
      x: width / 2 + x2 * scale,
      y: height * 0.46 - y2 * scale,
      z: z2,
      depth
    };
  }

  function drawBond(a, b, styleName) {
    const width = styleName === "line" || styleName === "backbone" ? 1.4 : 3.2;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(54, 71, 77, 0.72)";
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
    ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function drawAtom(point, styleName) {
    const atom = point.atom;
    const base = styleName === "sphere" ? 8.4 : styleName === "line" || styleName === "backbone" ? 3.1 : 5.6;
    const size = Math.max(2.4, base * (0.72 + elementRadius(atom.element) * 0.38) * Math.max(0.72, Math.min(1.22, point.depth)));
    const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(point.x - size * 0.32, point.y - size * 0.36, size * 0.18, point.x, point.y, size);
    gradient.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff");
    gradient.addColorStop(0.32, elementColor(atom.element));
    gradient.addColorStop(1, "#24343a");

    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(18, 35, 38, 0.25)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(point.x, point.y, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  function isTraceAtom(atom) {
    return currentFormat === "pdb" && atom.record === "ATOM" && (atom.name === "CA" || atom.name === "P");
  }

  function isLigandAtom(atom) {
    const solventNames = new Set(["HOH", "WAT", "SOL"]);
    return currentFormat === "pdb" && atom.record === "HETATM" && !solventNames.has(atom.residue);
  }

  function traceChains(projected) {
    const chains = new Map();

    projected.forEach(point => {
      if (!isTraceAtom(point.atom)) {
        return;
      }

      const key = point.atom.chain || "A";
      if (!chains.has(key)) {
        chains.set(key, []);
      }
      chains.get(key).push(point);
    });

    return Array.from(chains.entries()).map(([chain, points]) => ({
      chain,
      points: points.sort((a, b) => {
        const aSeq = Number.isFinite(a.atom.resSeq) ? a.atom.resSeq : a.atom.index;
        const bSeq = Number.isFinite(b.atom.resSeq) ? b.atom.resSeq : b.atom.index;
        return aSeq === bSeq ? a.atom.index - b.atom.index : aSeq - bSeq;
      })
    })).filter(group => group.points.length > 1);
  }

  function drawSmoothPath(points) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(points[0].x, points[0].y);

    if (points.length === 2) {
      ctx.lineTo(points[1].x, points[1].y);
      return;
    }

    for (let index = 1; index < points.length - 1; index += 1) {
      const current = points[index];
      const next = points[index + 1];
      const midX = (current.x + next.x) / 2;
      const midY = (current.y + next.y) / 2;
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(current.x, current.y, midX, midY);
    }

    const last = points[points.length - 1];
    ctx.lineTo(last.x, last.y);
  }

  function drawRibbon(points, color) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(12, 33, 38, 0.18)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(10, 31, 37, 0.22)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 18;
    drawSmoothPath(points);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();

    ctx.save();
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    ctx.strokeStyle = color;
    ctx.lineWidth = 13;
    drawSmoothPath(points);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    drawSmoothPath(points);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.restore();
  }

  function drawTraceTermini(points, color) {
    [points[0], points[points.length - 1]].forEach(point => {
      ctx.fillStyle = color;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(point.x, point.y, 5.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.stroke();
    });
  }

  function drawLigands(projected, styleName) {
    const visible = new Set(projected.filter(point => isLigandAtom(point.atom)).map(point => point.atom.index));
    if (!visible.size) {
      return;
    }

    const ligandBonds = bonds.map(([from, to]) => ({
      from,
      to,
      z: ((projected[from] && projected[from].z) || 0) + ((projected[to] && projected[to].z) || 0)
    })).filter(bond => visible.has(bond.from) && visible.has(bond.to)).sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);

    ligandBonds.forEach(bond => {
      const from = projected[bond.from];
      const to = projected[bond.to];
      if (from && to) {
        drawBond(from, to, styleName);
      }
    });

    projected.filter(point => visible.has(point.atom.index)).sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z).forEach(point => drawAtom(point, styleName));
  }

  function drawCartoon(projected) {
    const chains = traceChains(projected);

    if (!chains.length) {
      return false;
    }

    chains.sort((a, b) => {
      const aDepth = a.points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.z, 0) / a.points.length;
      const bDepth = b.points.reduce((sum, point) => sum + point.z, 0) / b.points.length;
      return aDepth - bDepth;
    }).forEach((group, index) => {
      const color = chainColors[index % chainColors.length];
      drawRibbon(group.points, color);
      drawTraceTermini(group.points, color);
    });

    drawLigands(projected, "stick");
    return true;
  }

  function drawBackbone(projected) {
    const chains = traceChains(projected);

    if (!chains.length) {
      return false;
    }

    ctx.lineWidth = 5;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    chains.forEach((group, index) => {
      ctx.strokeStyle = chainColors[index % chainColors.length];
      drawSmoothPath(group.points);
      ctx.stroke();
      group.points.forEach(point => drawAtom(point, "line"));
    });
    return true;
  }

  function render() {
    if (!ctx) {
      showStatus("Canvas rendering is unavailable in this browser.", true);
      return;
    }

    const { width, height } = resizeCanvas();
    const styleName = representationElement.value;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fbfaf7";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    if (!atoms.length) {
      return;
    }

    const projected = atoms.map(atom => projectAtom(atom, width, height));
    const bondDepths = bonds.map(([from, to]) => ({
      from,
      to,
      z: ((projected[from] && projected[from].z) || 0) + ((projected[to] && projected[to].z) || 0)
    })).sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z);

    if ((styleName === "cartoon" || styleName === "default") && currentFormat === "pdb" && drawCartoon(projected)) {
      return;
    }

    if (styleName === "backbone" && drawBackbone(projected)) {
      return;
    }

    if (styleName !== "sphere") {
      bondDepths.forEach(bond => {
        const from = projected[bond.from];
        const to = projected[bond.to];
        if (from && to) {
          drawBond(from, to, styleName);
        }
      });
    }

    projected.sort((a, b) => a.z - b.z).forEach(point => drawAtom(point, styleName));
  }

  function loadStructure(data, format, source) {
    currentFormat = format;
    currentSource = source;
    parseStructure(data, format);
    setMeta(format, source);
    render();
    showStatus("Loaded " + source + ".");
  }

  async function loadPdbById() {
    const pdbInput = document.getElementById("moleculePdbInput");
    const pdbId = pdbInput.value.trim().toUpperCase();

    if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{4}$/.test(pdbId)) {
      showStatus("Enter a valid four-character PDB ID.", true);
      return;
    }

    try {
      showStatus("Loading PDB " + pdbId + "...");
      const response = await fetch("https://files.rcsb.org/download/" + pdbId + ".pdb", { cache: "no-store" });
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("PDB " + pdbId + " could not be loaded.");
      }
      const pdbText = await response.text();
      loadStructure(pdbText, "pdb", "PDB " + pdbId);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      showStatus(error.message, true);
    }
  }

  function animate() {
    if (!isSpinning) {
      animationId = null;
      return;
    }

    rotation.y += 0.012;
    render();
    animationId = window.requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  document.getElementById("moleculeFileInput").addEventListener("change", async event => {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const format = detectFormat(file.name);
      const data = await file.text();
      loadStructure(data, format, file.name);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(error);
      showStatus(error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("moleculeLoadPdbButton").addEventListener("click", loadPdbById);

  document.getElementById("moleculePdbInput").addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.key === "Enter") {
      event.preventDefault();
      loadPdbById();
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("moleculeSampleButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    loadStructure(sampleXyz, "xyz", "Sample");
  });

  representationElement.addEventListener("change", render);

  document.getElementById("moleculeResetButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    rotation = { x: -0.55, y: 0.72, z: 0 };
    zoom = 1;
    render();
  });

  spinButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
    isSpinning = !isSpinning;
    spinButton.textContent = isSpinning ? "Stop" : "Spin";
    spinButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(isSpinning));

    if (isSpinning && !animationId) {
      animationId = window.requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById("moleculeDownloadButton").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    link.download = "kabir-lab-molecule.png";
    link.click();
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
    isDragging = true;
    lastPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
    canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    canvas.classList.add("is-dragging");
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", event => {
    if (!isDragging) {
      return;
    }

    const dx = event.clientX - lastPointer.x;
    const dy = event.clientY - lastPointer.y;
    rotation.y += dx * 0.01;
    rotation.x += dy * 0.01;
    lastPointer = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
    render();
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", event => {
    isDragging = false;
    canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    canvas.classList.remove("is-dragging");
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => {
    isDragging = false;
    canvas.classList.remove("is-dragging");
  });

  canvas.addEventListener("wheel", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    zoom = Math.max(0.35, Math.min(4.5, zoom * (event.deltaY > 0 ? 0.9 : 1.1)));
    render();
  }, { passive: false });

  window.addEventListener("resize", render);
  loadStructure(sampleXyz, "xyz", "Sample");
})();
</script>
```
